is_dominical.description: Whether the event is "of the Lord" (dominical). Optional; used by the Ambrosian proprium to distinguish Sundays and solemnities/feasts of the Lord from weekday ferie.

is_aliturgical.description: Whether the event is aliturgical (no Mass is celebrated). Used by the Ambrosian proprium for the aliturgical Fridays of Lent.

is_bvm.description: Whether the event is a celebration of the Blessed Virgin Mary. Optional; used by the Ambrosian precedence classifier to rank a memorial of the BVM above a memorial of a saint within the comune memorial tier. Not serialized in API responses.

since_year.description: First year in which the event is celebrated. Optional; when absent the event is not year-gated.

until_year.description: Last year in which the event is celebrated. Optional; when absent the event is not year-gated.
